notes.title: Update 1.4 Ambient fog and dust + more
notes.content:
[h1]Happy holidays![/h1]

In anticipation to our next Escape the Room game, we're pushing a small update that connects the lore of the games and improves the visuals.

[h1]In this update, we've added the following:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ambient fog[/*]
[*]Ambient dust particles[/*]
[*]Spacialized audio[/*]
[*]New ending location[/*]
[*]General quality improvments (mainly text rendering)[/*]
[/list]


We hope you enjoy this small update, and stay tuned for the next escape game! We've listened to your feedback and hope to improve in the next game. ːphotosmileː

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26227092/c1a69b5062821ea07950b71055d5236acb0119df.png[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix (sticky flashlight)(1.3a)
notes.content:
Just a quick update:

As requested, we made it so you don't have to hold down the trigger constantly for the flashlight. You can drop it with a single button.

Changes:

-"Sticky" flashlight. Press trigger to pick up and grip to drop.
-Updated controls in main menu.
-Further collision improvements. 


Sorry for all the updates today! :)

notes.title: Reuploaded Trailer and New Collision (Patch 1.3)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We just realized that the trailer on the store page was actually cut off for some reason - assumingly an error when it was uploaded. It's now been reuploaded and worth checking out!

In addition, we've reworked some of the collision. Most notably the flashlight and keys. Previously, people had an issue with objects falling throught he floor. This shouldn't happen anymore.

Changes:

-Fixed flashlight and key glitches.
-Enabled continuous collision detection for all objects.


Current known issues:

There seems to be a very small amount of people experiencing lag. From our observation, it may only affect those with a 980ti. We're looking into it.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Hey guys! We've fixed a few bugs and added a few things to make the game more enjoyable.

Changelog:

-Added subtle hints to help with puzzles (this will change in the future to a hint system. If you need more help, a guide is coming soon).

-Changed color of key for the cabinet to red. Many of you had problems mixing up the keys.

-Made the keys slightly larger so they're easier to find and keep up with. 

-Optimized the start screen a little better. 



Known issues:

-The game sometimes freezes if you exit from the steamvr dashboard. 
(A workaround is to simply alt-tab and exit manually. If you beat the game, there is an exit game button that works fine.)

-There may be some performance issues on some systems using SLI or have a lot of supersampling enabled. 

-There are some collision issues on the flashlight.
